name: forgegui
description: Generate and manage Roblox assets with your production ForgeGUI account.
long_description: Connects to ForgeGUI production. Generation uses your ForgeGUI credits. Roblox Studio requires a separate connection; this extension does not include Claude Code skills or terminal helpers.

forgegui_api_key.title: Production ForgeGUI API key
forgegui_api_key.description: Create a production key at forgegui.com, Profile → MCP API keys. Start with library:read for free verification. This is not a Roblox Open Cloud key.
